description: This file defines the TemplateDAO interface for database operations related to message templates in the OpenMRS system, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting templates.

classes.name: TemplateDAO
classes.description: Interface for template-related database functions in the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all message templates from the database.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a message template by its internal ID.

methods.name: getTemplatesByName
methods.description: Retrieves message templates that match the specified name.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new message template in the database.
